.ts file anywhere, so adding, removing or repointing a provider is an
edit here and nothing else. Validated against a Zod schema at load time

These are SEARCH URLs, deliberately. None of these companies has given
this app an API key, so nothing here claims live prices, availability or
booking state -- it hands the query to a site the student already uses
and gets out of the way. Inventing an integration we do not have would
mean showing numbers we cannot stand behind.
Placeholders: {query} is the URL-encoded search term. Any other
